help.title: Lambat National Registry
help.description: Official bot for tracking citizens, settlements, and population trends for the Lambat nation on CivMC.
help.citizen.add: `/citizen add` – Register a new citizen *(Council only)*
help.citizen.list: `/citizen list` – List all citizens by settlement
help.citizen.dossier: `/citizen dossier` – View a citizen's full dossier
help.settlement.remove: `/settlement remove` – Remove an empty settlement *(Council only)*
help.report.export: `/report export` – Download citizen data as CSV
help.server.status: `/server status` – Live server status, player count, MOTD
help.data.backup: `/data backup` – Create a manual database backup
help.data.restore: `/data restore` – Restore the database from a backup
help.owner.sync: `/sync` – Re-sync slash commands to this server *(owner only)*
help.footer: Lambat Registry Bot • Report issues to your nation leadership
monthly.title: # Summary of Lambat's Census of Population for {month_name}
monthly.total_registered: **Total Registered population (does not account for actual activity):** {total}
monthly.active_population: **Active population (all players who have logged on within the month)**: {active} ({pct}% of reg. citizens)
monthly.auth_broken: **Active population**: ⚠️ **Unavailable** — CivInfo API auth required. The numbers below are unreliable.
monthly.reg_change: Registered population change :    {pct}% from last month {arrow}
monthly.active_change: Active population change:    {pct}% from last month {arrow}
monthly.gain: Gain: +{new_citizens} new citizens (excludes removed/revoked recruits and returnees)
